name: Spec
reference: Vercel's Geist and Ship visuals, Rauno Freiberg and Evil Rabbit: a visible grid, hairlines, crosshairs, mono labels.
pattern: White, black and a grey scale of hairlines; colour only for status.
personality: A technical drawing of a product. Every element sits on the grid, labelled.

motion.character: Crisp. Lines draw, labels type on, rows reveal 40 ms apart; nothing overshoots.
motion.transitions: Hard cuts on the grid; a hairline wipe at most.

texture.note: None. 1 px hairlines and small + crosshairs at grid corners.

grammar: Draw the grid: hairline rules and + marks where lines cross.
Mono labels in the margins name what is shown.
Colour appears only as a status (positive, negative).

pictures.note: A neutral grey picture in a bordered window on the grid, labelled like a figure.

hits.note: A tick when a label snaps to the grid.

hook.how: The subject, measured, on frame 0: a figure of it with one dimension line and its value (`photo` with `frame: "figure"` and a `dimension`), or the key number in tabular display figures with a dimension line under it, when the film has an honest key number at the start. Never a number the film does not yet have. The line of the question in display by 0.5 s.

moves.move: The grid draws first: hairline rules and + marks where they cross; every element snaps to it.

measurable.how: Hairlines at the column positions show in at least one key frame.

moves.move: Labels type on in mono at 40 characters a second, a tick as each one snaps.

measurable.how: Each tick sits within 2 frames of its label's last character.

moves.move: A bordered figure window with a FIG. label holds the one picture.
A match cut: the picture cuts to the drawing on the same pixels, on a beat.

blocks.for: The visible grid, its crosshairs and the title block, complete; fitDrawing fills the frame with the drawing.

props.follow: the part's keys when it moves

blocks.for: The large number the film is about.
A label outside the drawing with a short leader to the part it names.
A reference picture in a bordered, labelled figure window.

props.run: the stops: the fixed end, each wheel (a `pulley`: r from fitDrawing, `turns` from rollDegrees) with its turn, the free end
props.light: the part of the rope the film explains

blocks.for: An open rope over pulleys (wheels with no teeth that turn by key marks): a hoist, a crane, a winch.

avoid.why: Spec labels and draws; it does not shout words.
A technical drawing has no pull quote.

ends.how: A last comparison drawn on the sheet (the answer beside its reference, with its dimension), then a final tick and a hold.
ends.with: the answer's dimension drawn last, a final tick from `hit({ on })`, then `hold` to the end

mix.note: Minimal and clean. Labels snap on its beats; the ticks are the only effects.

shots.match: One subject, drawn and photographed at one scale, so the match cut lands on the same pixels.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
